title: The Humiliation and Exaltation of Christ
definition: The humiliation and exaltation of Christ describe His descent in humility through incarnation and suffering, and His exaltation through resurrection, ascension, and reign.
summary: Christ humbled Himself to save sinners and was highly exalted by the Father.
christFocus: Jesus' path from humility to glory shows both the cost of redemption and the certainty of His reign.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christ humbled Himself to save sinners and was highly exalted by the Father.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
